title: Good product but to firm for us
text:
Good product but to firm for us. I’m sure some folks will like this, but way to firm for my wife and myself.
No problem with quality or company, just to firm for us

product_metadata.title: Blissful Nights Ananda Pearl and Gel Mid Loft Memory Foam Pillow (King)
features: This luxurious King-sized pillow blends cooling gel and natural crushed pearls directly into ventilated, premium memory foam.
A ventilated cooling channel design increases air circulation for a cooler sleep while unique cooling fibers are woven into the cover to help neutralizes temperature variations while you sleep.
The washable cover is constructed of a cooling Tencel fabric for a comfortable sleeping surface for your head and neck; delicate wash and low-heat dry recommended.
Made with three pounds of natural-crushed pearls and gel-infused memory foam for optimal head and neck support.
CertiPUR-US Certified foam; backed by a 3-year U.S. warranty against manufacturer defects.
